items.source: statement - a full Cypher statement, matching and returning all required nodes, relationships and properties
items.translation: statement - 一个完整的 Cypher 语句，用于匹配并返回所有必需的节点、关系和属性。

items.source: Creates a custom projection of the repository type by a Cypher-DSL based statement.
items.translation: 通过基于 Cypher-DSL 的语句创建存储库类型的自定义投影。

items.source: Find all elements of the domain as defined by the statement.
items.translation: 找出由statement定义的所有域元素。

items.source: An interface that can be added to any reactive repository so that the repository exposes several methods taking in a Statement from the Cypher-DSL, that allows for full customization of the queries executed in a programmatic way in contrast to provide custom queries declaratively via @Query annotations.
items.translation: 一个可添加到任何反应式存储库的接口，该接口使存储库能够暴露多个方法，这些方法接收来自 Cypher-DSL 的 Statement，从而允许以编程方式完全自定义执行的查询，这与通过 @Query 注解以声明方式提供自定义查询形成对比。

items.source: Find one element of the domain as defined by the statement.
items.translation: 在由 `statement` 定义的域中找到一个元素。

items.source: Find one element of the domain as defined by the statement. The statement must return either no or exactly one mappable record.
items.translation: 在由 `statement` 定义的域中找到一个元素。该语句必须返回零个或恰好一个可映射的记录。

items.source:
Creates a custom projection of the repository type by a Cypher-DSL based statement.
The statement must return either no or exactly one mappable record.
items.translation: 通过基于 Cypher-DSL 的语句创建仓库类型的自定义投影。该语句必须返回零个或恰好一个可映射的记录。

items.source: T - the domain type of the repository
an empty Mono or a Mono containing the single element
items.translation: 一个空的 Mono 或包含单个元素的 Mono

items.source: an empty Mono or a Mono containing the single, projected element
items.translation: 一个空的 Mono 或包含单个投影元素的 Mono。
